title: RepositoryAnalysisRequested
description:
Payload of `knowledge.repository_analysis.requested.v1`.

GitHub Catalog requests admission only. Knowledge owns budget admission, work execution,
retries and the analysis result; a request remains pending until it receives one terminal fact.

github_repository_numeric_id.description: Stable GitHub numeric repository identity, never derived from `owner/name`.

idempotency_key.description: Catalog-generated idempotency key for the same repository revision and contract.

owner.description: User whose repository policy caused this request.

repository_attributes.description: Bounded repository attributes whose digest is named by `source_revision`.

repository_id.description: Catalog-owned identity of the repository to analyse.

request_id.description: Join key minted once for this accepted request.

requested_contract.description: Exact analysis family requested. This first contract admits no alternative major.

source_revision.description: Immutable input revision Knowledge must analyse.

BlobOwner.title: BlobOwner
BlobOwner.description: Deployment identity of the service that owns and resolves a blob.

BlobRef.description:
Reference to content-addressed bytes owned by one service.

This is a reference, not a storage API. The owner writes and resolves the bytes under its own
content-addressed directory. No host, filesystem path, signed URL, credentials, or expiry can
appear in this contract.

digest.description: Digest that names the bytes and lets a reader verify them.

length_bytes.description: Exact byte length of the stored value.

media_type.description: Media type of the stored bytes.

owner_service.description: Service that owns the bytes and their lifecycle.

ContentDigest.description: A content digest with an explicit algorithm.

DigestAlgorithm.description: Algorithm used to calculate a content digest.

DigestHex.title: DigestHex
DigestHex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal bytes of a content digest.

MediaType.title: MediaType
MediaType.description: Internet media type of stored bytes, without parameters.

ReadmeAbsenceReason.description: Safe reasons why a README is absent from the immutable input.

oneOf.description: GitHub reported that the repository has no README at this revision.
Catalog policy did not authorize the README to leave the GitHub boundary.
The README could not be preserved into a content-addressed reference.

ReadmeRevision.description: README input state for repository analysis.

oneOf.description: A content-addressed README is available to the authorized consumer.

content_ref.description: Reference to the exact README bytes. The reference carries its content digest.

oneOf.description: No README bytes are an input for this revision.

reason.description: Why a README is absent, without leaking provider diagnostics or private content.

RepositoryAnalysisAttributes.description: Bounded repository metadata supplied alongside its immutable digest.

description.description: Repository description when GitHub supplied a non-empty value.

primary_language.description: Primary language when GitHub supplied one.

repository_full_name.description: Observed mutable alias at the immutable metadata revision.

RepositoryAnalysisContract.description: The only repository-analysis family available in this contract.

RepositoryAnalysisRequestId.description: Identity of one repository-analysis request. Bare canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID; used to join terminal facts to the accepted request.

RepositoryAnalysisRevision.description: Immutable metadata and README state of the repository input.

attributes_digest.description: Digest of the normalized repository attributes observed by GitHub Catalog.

RepositoryDescription.title: RepositoryDescription
RepositoryDescription.description: Bounded repository description supplied as analysis input.

RepositoryFullName.title: RepositoryFullName

RepositoryId.description: Identity of one repository record in the GitHub Catalog. Bare canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID; not GitHub's numeric repository identifier.

RepositoryLanguage.description: Bounded primary-language label supplied as analysis input.
